judged_text: The embed allowlist check moved from an in-memory cached SiteSetting to an unconditional per-request DB query (EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? -> where(lower(host) = ?)) on the public, unauthenticated, high-traffic /embed/comments path, and the LOWER(host) predicate is non-sargable so no index on host can serve it. Every comment-iframe request from every embedded site now costs a full-table scan on embeddable_hosts; a site with heavy embedding traffic pays a DB roundtrip per request where the previous design served the answer from the cached settings object, and the table will grow one row per host with no caching layer to absorb it.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the public embed allowlist check from SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? to EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? (EmbedController#ensure_embeddable now calls EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)). EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? does a DB lookup via record_for_host -> where("lower(host) = ?", host). The migration creates embeddable_hosts without any index on host, and the LOWER(host) predicate would not use a plain index anyway, so this introduces a per-request DB roundtrip and likely table-scan behavior on a potentially high-traffic unauthenticated endpoint. This is a performance/architecture concern grounded in the diff, not a functional correctness bug.
